title: Compact landing hero flow cards
summary: Adjusted the landing hero flow so cards are smaller and the animated path lives in a dedicated gutter between the cards and annotations, instead of running under the card surfaces. This creates more visible separation between Plan, Snapshot, and Commit states and reduces the weird overlap when inactive cards are dimmed.
userVisibleChange: The landing hero flow now has smaller cards, more breathing room, and an animated path that reads as a connector between stages rather than a line underneath inactive cards.

risks.title: Browser screenshot could not be recaptured in this turn
risks.mitigation: The local preview server could not be restarted earlier due the app usage limit. The CSS-only change was checked by source review and production build.

timeline.title: Compacted hero nodes
timeline.summary: Reduced card widths, icon sizes, padding, and typography; moved path and dots to a right-side gutter; updated desktop and mobile path coordinates.

timeline.title: Built site
timeline.summary: Ran the production Next.js build and whitespace checks successfully.

decisions.title: Move the hero path into a gutter
decisions.rationale: The previous path x-position ran through the cards, making inactive cards and connector dots visually compete. Moving it beside the compact nodes lets the path animate between steps without passing under card content.

decisions.title: Compact node sizing instead of increasing the whole hero further
decisions.rationale: The hero already had ample height; shrinking cards and tightening internal type/icon sizes creates clearer gaps without pushing the rest of the landing page farther down.

validation.output: Next.js production build completed successfully; 19 static pages generated.
No whitespace errors in the compact-card CSS patch.
